Set `Table(expand=True)` and give `Biography` a `ratio`, for example `table.add_column("Biography", ratio=1, no_wrap=True, overflow="ellipsis")`. Column ratios take effect when the table expands or has an explicit width, letting the other columns keep their measured widths while `Biography` uses the remaining space. See the [table options](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst#table-options) and [column options](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst#column-options). For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
